_comment: 1974 賽季導言 facts pack。clinch 已用 SeasonOracle 驗證：emerson_fittipaldi 的 clinch round=15＝last_round=15（即全季最終站，美國站），故正文『延燒到全季最終站』屬經 oracle 驗證的事實，但因不帶阿拉伯數字，未另立 clinch_round claim（依 README，語意主張不強制走 clinch kind，只有數字/順位詞才需要 anchor）。分差（55－52＝3）未寫進正文，避免與 champion_wins/constructor_wins 的裸數字 3 混淆（依站規：分差不能直接寫，除非兩個積分各有 claim）。

claims.source: sqlite: SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year=1974

claims.text: 菲蒂帕爾迪最終以 55 分封王
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT points FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1974 AND position=1（driver_id=emerson_fittipaldi）；另以 results＋scoring-rules.json 逐站重算對照一致
sqlite: SELECT points FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1974 AND position=2（driver_id=regazzoni）；另以 results＋scoring-rules.json 逐站重算對照一致

claims.text: 菲蒂帕爾迪該季贏下 3 場分站冠軍
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT wins FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1974 AND position=1（driver_id=emerson_fittipaldi）；另以 results COUNT(position_text='1') 逐站重算對照一致

claims.text: 麥拉倫同季共拿下 4 場分站冠軍
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE season=1974 AND constructor_id='mclaren' AND position_text='1'

claims.text: 法拉利該季拿下 3 場分站冠軍
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE season=1974 AND constructor_id='ferrari' AND position_text='1'
